briefing.headline: US-China AI export controls tighten as OpenAI and DeepSeek race toward agentic systems

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multi-agent deployments while governments impose stricter chip controls. Funding remains robust despite regulatory headwinds. DialectForge protocol gains traction in enterprise security evaluations.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4-preview with 40% gains in long-horizon planning. DeepSeek-V4 matches GPT-5 on coding benchmarks. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus debuts constitutional AI v2 for reduced hallucination.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with pilots in automotive CAN bus and BCI reported this week.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Nvidia ships 1.2M Blackwell GPUs in Q2. Microsoft announces $15B data center expansion in Texas. TSMC ramps 2nm process for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will agentic AI systems achieve autonomous goal pursuit before 2028 regulatory frameworks take effect?
